_comment: Standing floors for scripts/coverage_delta.py: the least number of
non-empty values a column of a published CSV must have, checked on
every build against the build itself. A new column is covered from the
build that introduces it. Raise a floor when coverage improves; lowering

county_fips.reason: Derived by classify.county_fips from state plus county. 149 of 165 rows hit on 2026-10-01 (DeWitt County, IL now matches De Witt); the other 16 are in data/review/fips_misses.csv.

county_fips_all.reason: Every county a project touches (classify.county_fips_all), multi-county names included. 163 of 165 on 2026-10-06: Ellington and Manchester, Connecticut, are placed in their 2022 planning region by the town their record names; the other 2 Connecticut rows name only a pre-2022 county.

county_fips.reason: Derived by classify.county_fips for County, Parish and Borough jurisdictions. 313 of 317 such rows hit on 2026-09-30; the other 4 are in data/review/fips_misses.csv.

county_fips_all.reason: County-level instruments by name, town-level ones by coordinates and by the Census place index (data/place_county_index.json). 602 of 610 on 2026-10-06, up from 585 on 2026-10-02: a county typed as a municipality and Honolulu's consolidated city-county by name, 4 shared town names by the county their own text names (place_text), and 11 rows by reviewer overrides with evidence (data/review/place_overrides.csv). The other 8 are 7 town names shared by several counties (left unplaced, never guessed) and Prairie, KS, which matches no county.
